jess_support: Heads up — several hosted API customers seeing 502/504s on text-gen endpoints starting ~09:10PT. Pattern looks like cache/KV prefix failures causing timeouts. Repro steps & logs below.

irina_runtime: seeing a big spike in prefix lookup timeouts on pfx-01/us-west-2, memcached auth retries around the same window.

irina_runtime: ```
[09:11:03] pfx-lookup: GET prefix=org:acct:xyz shard=pfx-01 -> timeout(1500ms)
[09:11:04] memcached[pfx-01]: auth retry=3 err="TLS handshake timeout"
[09:11:05] kv-fallback: store-get latency 320ms -> upstream DB
[09:11:06] gateway: request_id=rg-9af2 502 upstream_timeout cache_failure
```

marco_sre: can you paste a customer request_id and sample curl? I want to pull traces.

jess_support: sample curl from customer (x-request-id header included):

jess_support: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" -H "X-Request-ID: rg-9af2" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n{"error":"upstream timeout (cache lookup)"}
```

olivia_customer: customer "Crepe Labs" reported a spike in 502s around 09:12; they repro'd by firing ~80 concurrent requests for batch scoring. Said it was intermittent and recovery briefly happened then flapped.

matt_oncall: quick mitigation ideas: 1) flip prefix-prefetch off for hosted region (disable prefetch rollout flag) 2) temporarily increase memcached pool size for pfx-tagged pools 3) route traffic to fallback model variant with local caching disabled for affected customers.

jess_support: doing 1 now — toggling feature flag for prefetch in us-west-2. Will notify customers.

deploy-bot: action=start scale memcached pool pfx-usw2 from 8 -> 12 instances (triggered by jess_support)

irina_runtime: note — disabling prefetch will increase DB load (we're already seeing DB slow queries). We should throttle and add TTL jitter to reduce hotkey stampede. Also enabling circuit breaker on prefix lookup to fail faster and avoid backlog.

marco_sre: pulled traces for rg-9af2: cache RPC latency stacked, threads exhausted, gateway timed out waiting for prefix lookup. Correlation: memcached auth failures preceded the spike by ~30s.

marco_sre: ```
trace rg-9af2: gateway -> prefix-lookup -> memcached[pfx-01] (TLS err) -> retry -> timeout -> fallback -> DB
```

jess_support: escalation summary for CS ticket: customers A/B/C impacted intermittently in us-west-2 between 09:10-09:22PT. Primary root cause suspected memcached auth flapping on pfx-01 causing prefix missstorms and downstream DB overload -> 502/504s.

olivia_customer: any ETA on full resolution? Customers are asking for status updates.

matt_oncall: short term ETA: flag flip + pool scale should reduce errors in ~10-15m. medium term: patch memcached client to backoff earlier and deploy prefix circuit breaker. I'll own action items.

irina_runtime: creating follow-up runbook items: add alert for memcached auth error rate, add per-prefix rate limiter, make prefetch rollout conditional on memcached healthy state.

jess_support: noted, creating support ticket and emailing impacted customers now. Will update here when errors drop below baseline. :thumbsup:

matt_oncall: thanks — monitoring logs and gauge. If errors persist after 15m I'll open an incident and bring in infra lead.

deploy-bot: action=done scale memcached pool pfx-usw2 -> 12 (completed)

jess_support: 09:26PT — error rate trending down, customers reporting improvement. Closing escalation but keeping follow-up tasks assigned.

marco_sre: postmortem req'd — adding to backlog with label "kv-prefetch-missstorm-usw2". Recommend RCA to include config that allowed prefetch to continue despite memcached auth flaps.

jess_support: thanks everyone. I'll file the CS follow-ups and link the incident doc once posted.
